title: BioPyTools: A modular command-line toolkit for reproducible bioinformatics workflows
description: BioPyTools is a Python command-line toolkit for reproducible bioinformatics workflows. It provides modular commands for sequencing-data quality control, genome assembly and annotation, variant analysis, pangenomics, phylogenetics, population genetics, microbiome analysis, and effector prediction, with shared validation, logging, checkpointing, software-version reporting, and Conda/HPC execution support.
